verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a public REST v3 API for building integrations and automating workspace workflows. It shows create, delete and list endpoints for objects such as Categories and Milestones, and machine-readable Swagger/OpenAPI specs are claimed. Nothing in the pack asserts or demonstrates that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, and the probes did not find the OpenAPI spec at the guessed paths. That leaves parity unproven but does not contradict it. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity claim, endpoint coverage evidence for UI features like Docs, Roadmaps, Goals, Iterations and automations, a reachable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use this API to build custom integrations or automate even more of your workspace’s workflow.
Create Category allows you to create a new Category in Shortcut.
Delete Category can be used to delete any Category.
We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
